snippet.title: Blitzstrike  - Official Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
Face off against waves of enemies, uncover the truth behind your mysterious pursuer, and strike back with full firepower in this explosive, neon-drenched side-scrolling action game! 

Meet Trixel, the brave, bubbly, pink-haired bounty hunter who makes light work of dangerous robots hunting her down. But who is controlling them?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654000/Blitzstrike/

Fast. Flashy. Fully loaded.
Coming Spring 2025.
